scripts.build:wasm:web: wasm-pack build plotive-wasm --dev --target web --out-dir ../dist/esm/wasm && rm -f dist/esm/wasm/.gitignore dist/esm/wasm/package.json dist/esm/wasm/README.md
scripts.build:wasm:node: wasm-pack build plotive-wasm --dev --target nodejs --out-dir ../dist/cjs/wasm && rm -f dist/cjs/wasm/.gitignore dist/cjs/wasm/package.json dist/cjs/wasm/README.md
scripts.build:wasm: pnpm run build:wasm:web && pnpm run build:wasm:node
scripts.build: pnpm run clean && pnpm run build:wasm && pnpm run build:ts
scripts.example:dev: pnpm run build && pnpm run example:install && pnpm --dir example run dev
scripts.example:build: pnpm run build && pnpm run example:install && pnpm --dir example run build
